description: Parse a name into prefix, first, middle, last and suffix. Paid deep adds gender evidence, salutation, short and directory formats, and initials. Country scopes gender evidence. name_locale selects formatting rules. Junk returns valid false.

country.description: ISO2 country context for gender, e.g. IT

deep.description: Include the complete detail bag on a paid plan.

name.description: The name to parse, e.g. Smith, John or BILLY OSHALL

name_locale.description: Name-formatting locale, e.g. en or ja. Defaults to en. Changes formatting only, not parsing or gender evidence.

name: name
